name: Helio
subtitle: Privacy-focused Reddit client
description: Helio is a privacy-focused, open-source Reddit client for iOS and Mac. No analytics, no tracking, no ads. Sign in with your Reddit account; no API key is needed. Sideloaded builds can't use iCloud, so data stays on the device.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed
* feat: Apollo-style foundation on iOS 26 by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/1
* build: move the app's code into a Swift package by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/2
* feat: adapt layout to the window for iPhone Duo and Mac by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/3
* feat: polish the Mac app and rename it to Helio by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/5
* refactor: rename Winston to Helio by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/6
* fix: make the feed's floating button tappable and optional by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/7
* ci: add lint, build/test on PRs, and IPA/Mac releases with a sideload feed by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/8
* feat: Apollo-style look with Liquid Glass chrome by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/9
* perf: cut Reddit API calls and main-thread work by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/11
* docs: add AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md, vendor autoreview, and tidy credits by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/10
* fix: stop feeds from hanging on the spinner or showing stale pages by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/12
* feat: sign in with a Reddit account by default, no API key needed by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/14
* refactor: centralize feed and request ownership by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/13
* refactor(auth): serialize credential-store changes by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/15
* refactor: persist account lists under captured authorization by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/16
* refactor: remove dead code and fix multireddit sorting by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/18
* ci: build and release with Xcode 27.2 for iPhone Duo by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/19
* fix: navigation, inbox, quick actions and search fixes by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/20
* feat: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and contrast across feeds and posts by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/21
* feat: move floating controls into system bars and menus by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/22
* feat: show the feed and open post side by side on wide layouts by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/23
* feat: system sidebar selection, keyboard commands and Home on launch by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/24
* feat: put each screen's actions in the Mac window toolbar by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/25
* feat: theme gallery, text size and Canvas layout by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/26
* fix(mac): finish web sign-in, theme the sidebar and open links in the app by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/28
* feat(mac): run your own web extensions in pages opened from links by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/29
* perf: benchmark the Mac app, decode feed images at their shown width, and reuse Mac toolbar items by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/31
* docs: restyle the README with labeled screenshots for each platform by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/32
* feat: show the feed and the open post side by side on the open iPhone Duo by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/33
* fix: title the subreddit list "Subreddits" instead of "Subs" by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/35
* feat: remove the Posts Box and put Reddit Save in its place by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/36
* feat: log out of an account from the account switcher by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/37
* feat: run your web extensions on iPhone and iPad too by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/38
* fix: stop Debug builds crashing when the screen rotates by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/40
* feat: scrub videos and GIFs by swiping sideways in fullscreen by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/34
* fix: keep comment and feed rows small enough to survive rotation in Debug builds by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/41
* feat: update the Mac app in place with Sparkle by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/42
* chore: prepare the first release, 0.1.0 by @sozercan in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/43

## New Contributors
* @sozercan made their first contribution in https://github.com/sozercan/helio/pull/1
